suggestions.description: The captured demo/offline library refresh reports Saved even though the action performs neither an update check nor a save, leaving the requested operation's result unclear.
evidence: The candidate PNG shows only a Saved toast after the library refresh action.
The case sidecar records demo=true, offline=true, busy=false, and message=Saved; scripts/verify-handoff-ui.py:988-991 triggers library/refresh for this capture.
src/app/actions.rs:2028-2033 short-circuits demo refresh_library with notify(tr(saved)) and returns before an update worker or the offline error path.
HANDOFF.md section 5.1 calls for update-check feedback, while the retained real-state contract requires honest unavailable/operation state and excludes simulated successful operations.
suggestions.recommendation: Use explicit demo/offline feedback stating that updates were not checked. For real update requests, show a truthful checking state and the actual completion/error result. Preserve the existing compact outlined lower-toast geometry.

limitations: This is an independent review of exactly eight listed candidate PNGs. No independent reference image was provided or opened; geometry conclusions are limited to the applicable textual contract and visible consistency.

All eight images were individually viewed and their current SHA-256 values matched both the batch manifest and case screenshot evidence. Existing mechanical checks were consulted for identity and recorded state, not substituted for visual review.

PW filter 4 is injected by the capture harness even though the public PW category bar is defined with four tabs. This case does not prove a required fifth PW entry, its discoverability, or a public tab-selection defect.
The update-feedback finding is demonstrated in the captured demo/offline branch. No conclusion about a live online update request or its eventual worker result is drawn from this batch.

The cancellation image proves the visible closed-panel state only. The migration-options image covers an empty offline candidate list and toggled options, not real target selection, committed migration, read/category persistence, tracking transfer, or original-download deletion.

One static empty migration panel cannot establish how sheet height responds to other candidate counts or longer content. No exact PW migration-panel screenshot exists in the declared reference matrix.

Static PNGs cannot establish interaction hit targets, outside dismissal, toast duration, refresh timing, network work, physical hardware capabilities, wake restoration, or operation within 512 MiB. No local or remote runtime verification was performed by this reviewer.

Actual record titles, counts, progress, timestamps, and fixture or missing-cover artwork are permitted data variations. Closed-reader artwork-only behavior, hardware-absence variants, quality settings, and authorization states are outside these eight images.
This batch contains one actionable suggestion and does not establish a complete clean review round or contribute a complete-matrix clean-round claim.
